query:
WITH chosen AS (
 SELECT r.run_id,r.created_at FROM reporting.report_run r
 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reporting.report_request q WHERE q.run_id=r.run_id AND q.state='completed')
 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
), sample AS (
 SELECT r.*,q.request_id FROM chosen r JOIN reporting.report_request q USING(run_id)
 WHERE q.state='completed' ORDER BY q.request_id LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.run_id,s.request_id,t.topic_name,m.status AS delivery_state,
       a.app_name AS producer,cg.group_name AS consumer_group
FROM sample s JOIN message m ON m.msg_key IN (s.run_id::text,s.request_id::text)
JOIN topic t USING(topic_id)
JOIN application a ON a.app_id=m.producer_app_id
LEFT JOIN consumer_group cg ON cg.group_id=m.claimed_by
WHERE t.topic_name IN ('report-prepare','report-render') ORDER BY t.topic_name;
